authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 (verbatim structure frozen; V2 goal = stable candidate resource-scheduling layer, NOT repairing V1, NOT alpha)

architecture_frozen.pipeline: Universe -> Hard Exclusions ONLY -> Observation Pool -> {LONG structural | MID emerging | SHORT event} sources -> UNION -> candidate_source[] per stock -> + market regime metadata (daily + 20d mode) + sector context metadata -> Candidate Pool
architecture_frozen.no_hard_and_gates: LONG/MID/SHORT are independent candidate sources, never chained AND filters (V1 negative conclusion frozen)
architecture_frozen.observation_pool_restraint: basic research eligibility ONLY: >=120 sessions history; tradable (>=10 active days in trailing 60); data completeness; liquidity (20d mean volume >= market 2nd percentile at T); no low-price anomaly (qfq close >= 2.0). NO stealth alpha conditions. Declared OBSERVABILITY_LIMITATION: st_flag/free_float/turnover_rate unavailable in DATA-1 — carried as marker on every pool row, never fabricated

source_definitions: inherited VERBATIM from cd4_preregistration (T_LONG: close>500d mean & 24m ret>0; T_MID: 65d ret>0 & v20>1.5x own 250d median volume; T_SHORT: within trailing 20 sessions a 60-session new high on a day with vol>2x trailing-20 mean) — NO threshold changes

regime_metadata_frozen.regime_20d_mode: trailing 20-session MODE of regime_daily, fully trailing, window NOT searched, NOT adjusted by V2 outcomes; raw daily value always retained alongside

evaluation_frozen.recall: share of forward-60d top-decile market-relative-return stocks (among Observation Pool, evaluation only) retained by each source-set; EVALUATION ONLY — never selects thresholds/windows/rules
evaluation_frozen.incremental_protocol: LONG -> +MID -> +SHORT; each step reports pool_size, recall, incremental_recall (pp), incremental_pool_cost (stocks added per pp)
evaluation_frozen.seven_intersections: L-only / M-only / S-only / L&M / L&S / M&S / L&M&S with count, recall contribution, median tenure, regime distribution
evaluation_frozen.tenure: (a) monthly: consecutive checkpoints in candidate pool (and per-source membership runs), P(remain after +1/+3/+6 checkpoints), re-entry rate; (b) daily-continuity: re-run frozen trailing source definitions at +5/+20/+60 trade days after each checkpoint, P(source still true)
evaluation_frozen.regime_stratification: source pool sizes + recall by regime_20d_mode — CONTEXT ONLY; regime-specific thresholds PROHIBITED
evaluation_frozen.pareto_frontier: over source-set combinations {L, M, S, L|M, L|S, M|S, L|M|S}: (median pool size, median recall, median monthly Jaccard stability, regime robustness = recall range across regimes); report NON-DOMINATED points only, no single 'best'
evaluation_frozen.empty_pools_legal: any source may be empty in some regimes (Observation Pool persisting is what matters)

six_mandatory_questions.Q4: union raises recall substantially at reasonable pool size?
six_mandatory_questions.Q6_COMPLETION_GATE: stable candidate->episode input for CD-5 established?
